include_debug.title: Include Debug

message.description: User message sent to the chat API. V3 write handoff supports explicit product IDs such as TECH-KEY-010 and same-thread candidate selection such as 1.
message.title: Message

thread_id.description: Optional conversation/thread identifier. Recommended for same-thread candidate selection context.
thread_id.title: Thread Id

user_id.description: Optional user identifier. Required when a write handoff creates or confirms a pending action.
user_id.title: User Id

answer.description: Assistant answer returned by the backend.
answer.title: Answer

authoritative_run_id.description: Winner Run identity for an in-progress idempotency recovery response.
authoritative_run_id.title: Authoritative Run Id

debug.description: Optional structured debug metadata when requested. V3 handoff debug may include multi_agent_handoff, write_handoff_debug, candidate_context events, and confirmation events.
debug.title: Debug

pending_action_id.description: Pending action identifier when user confirmation is required.
pending_action_id.title: Pending Action Id

projection_error.description: Stable public projection error for a corrupt persisted recommendation; run state is unchanged.

recommendation.description: Structured catalog recommendation when the Recommendation Gate handled the request.

recommendation_context.description: Stable source run identifier for creating a recommendation-backed action.

retry_state.description: Machine-readable transport/retry state. In-progress is recoverable and is not terminal failure.
retry_state.title: Retry State

run_id.description: Opaque persisted run identifier returned only when include_debug=true.
run_id.title: Run Id

runtime_error_code.description: Machine-readable runtime error code when a retry/recovery state is present.
runtime_error_code.title: Runtime Error Code

status.description: Chat processing status. Stable public values are completed, confirmation_required, cancelled, and failed.
status.title: Status

thread_id.description: Conversation/thread identifier echoed back to the caller when provided.
thread_id.title: Thread Id

tool_calls.description: Names of tools called by the ShopMind Agent, for example prepare_add_to_cart, confirm_add_to_cart, or cancel_pending_action.
tool_calls.title: Tool Calls

trace_id.description: Opaque trace identifier returned only when include_debug=true.
trace_id.title: Trace Id

user_id.description: User identifier echoed back to the caller when provided.
user_id.title: User Id

confirmed.description: Whether the user confirmed the pending action.
confirmed.title: Confirmed

expected_version.description: Client-held PendingAction version. Required when confirming or cancelling a canonical SKU add-to-cart action.
expected_version.title: Expected Version

include_debug.description: Return optional debug metadata for evaluation and troubleshooting.
include_debug.title: Include Debug

pending_action_id.description: Pending action identifier to confirm or cancel.
pending_action_id.title: Pending Action Id

thread_id.description: Optional conversation/thread identifier echoed back to the caller.
thread_id.title: Thread Id

updated_arguments.description: Optional server-validated edits applied atomically before confirmation. Editable fields depend on the persisted action type.
updated_arguments.title: Updated Arguments

user_id.description: User identifier for the pending action.
user_id.title: User Id

OwnerRunEventSummary.description: Client-visible event metadata with no arbitrary event payload.
OwnerRunEventSummary.title: OwnerRunEventSummary

OwnerRunInspection.description: Exact-owner run projection safe for the reference client.
OwnerRunInspection.title: OwnerRunInspection

ProjectionError.description: Safe public projection failure for a completed persisted run.
ProjectionError.title: ProjectionError

RecommendationRequest.description: Shared request envelope with bounded category-owned attributes.
RecommendationRequest.title: RecommendationRequest
